prerequisites: LC-1110 or LC-1124 Writing Skills for Engineers 1 already completed and passed.

learning_outcomes.text: identify and apply typical patterns for organising information within a text, such as the problem-solution pattern and extended definitions
use topic sentences and other cohesive strategies to write reader-friendly documents and paragraphs
develop their information retrieval skills as well as find reliable sources in the digital environment.

syllabus_topics: Typical patterns and strategies for organising paragraphs and documents for professional and academic purposes
Process approach to writing a short professional type of document related to their own field of study
Application of organisational patterns (problem-solution, extended definition, topic sentences) and other writing principles for better comprehension
Giving and receiving constructive peer feedback
teaching_methods: Applying a process approach to writing
